title: Vertical masonry foundation elements.
officialText:
Special inspection shall be performed in accordance with Section 1704.5 for vertical
masonry foundation elements.
Exception: Piers for support of lightweight fences, recreational equipment, site furnishings and similar construction, unless special
inspection is specifically noted as required on the approved construction documents.
